description_en: Calls UpdateRecordTask to update a video recording task
description_zh: 调用UpdateRecordTask更新录制视频任务
kebab_example: aliyun rtc update-record-task --sub-spec-users userID --sub-spec-audio-users audioUserID --sub-spec-share-screen-users videoUserID --sub-spec-camera-users cameraUserID --unsub-spec-audio-users audioUserID2 --unsub-spec-share-screen-users videoUserID2 --unsub-spec-camera-users cameraUserID2 --user-panes '[{"UserId":"TestId","Images":[{"ZOrder":0,"X":0.7576,"Y":0.7576,"Height":0.2456,"Width":0.2456,"Url":"https://www.example.com/image.jpg","Display":1}],"SourceType":"camera","Texts":[{"FontSize":1,"ZOrder":0,"FontColor":0,"X":0.7576,"Y":0.7576,"Text":"text","FontType":0}],"PaneId":1}]' --layout-ids 1 --app-id yourAppId --channel-id yourChannelId --task-id yourTaskId --template-id 76dasgb0000 --task-profile example-string --crop-mode 1 --media-encode 1 --region cn-hangzhou
name: UpdateRecordTask

element_fields.description_en:
Pane ID. N value: **1 to 16**. PaneID value: **0 to 15**.

> If the user specified by PaneId cannot be found, other streams are displayed by default. The streams are determined based on the order in which users join the channel.
